_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
chiefs: The Chiefs' WHL season runs late September to March at the Arena, 34 home dates, with the playoffs beyond that for the top eight in the Western Conference.
indians: The Indians' Northwest League season runs early April to September at Avista Stadium, 66 home dates; the schedule above fills in once the league publishes it over the winter.
velocity: Velocity's USL League One season runs March to October at ONE Spokane Stadium, 15 home matches, with the playoffs through November; the fixture list arrives over the winter.
gonzaga: The Zags' season runs November to March at the Kennel, with the WCC tournament in Las Vegas and the NCAA tournament beyond that; the non-conference schedule is announced in late summer.
eagles: The Eagles' Big Sky season runs late August to November on the red turf at Roos Field in Cheney, five or six home dates, with the FCS playoffs beyond that.
seahawks: The Seahawks' season runs September to January at Lumen Field in Seattle, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
mariners: Spring training opens in Peoria in February and the regular season in late March at T-Mobile Park in Seattle; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
kraken: The Kraken's season runs October to April at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, 41 home dates, with the playoffs beyond that for the top eight in the Western Conference.
